text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Would you like to bask in 
the s... take a break with me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This spot is just right for taking a 
break. Even when the sun is high in the 
sky, it's not too hot, just comfortably 
warm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! S-Sorry about that! ...Ehehe. Just 
goes to show it's so relaxing it'll make 
you doze right off.
